title: My Son-in-Law Took My Husband's Truck Keys at Dinner. He Didn't Know Who His Landlord Was.
description:
At a steakhouse in front of the whole family, my son-in-law reached across the table and took my husband's truck keys. He said we were too old to drive and too old to handle our own money. He had no idea who collects the rent on the ground under his car lot.

Stay until our fiftieth anniversary party. That's when I asked for the microphone.
